lines.text: Aftertake is not another topic-in, video-out machine. It is your editorial brain.
It learns your voice, hooks, titles, and thumbnails from your catalog and real performance.
Then it decides what to make next — with a fit score tied to your own best-performing traits.
Script, video, and captions generate in your established style — powered by HyperFrames.
Thumbnails and titles follow your formula — not generic templates.
A style-fit gate scores every asset. Below threshold — reject, regenerate, then pass. Judgment, not a fixed script.
Preview, publish, and close the loop. Aftertake — decide what to make, and whether it is actually you.
